data.one_liner: Query and manage Android device administrator policies and lock the screen.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to interact with the Android DevicePolicyManager. It enables requesting device administrator permissions, locking the device immediately, checking permission status, removing admin privileges, and checking camera status.
use_when: You need to lock the Android device programmatically from your app.
Your application requires Android device administrator privileges.
avoid_when: You are building for iOS or other platforms not supporting Android DevicePolicyManager.
You do not want to prompt the user for device administrator permissions.
strengths: Provides straightforward methods to lock the screen and manage admin permissions.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of native AndroidManifest.xml and policies.xml files.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding a receiver to AndroidManifest.xml and creating a policies.xml file inside res/xml.
